topic: Displaying facility names on inventory map
summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding the display of facility identifiers on the inventory map. Currently, the system uses `facility_id`, which is difficult for users to interpret visually. It was proposed that the map should display the human-readable `facility_name` instead. Someone noted that the facility name should already be available on staging environments. The conversation concluded with a lighthearted exchange about improvements being implemented.
decisions: Use of `facility_name` for displaying facilities on the inventory map is discussed.
